(Keyword is ‘WAS’)
reviews.cons:
Everything in the current state.
- 0 job security. Layoffs almost every 2 months
- Appraisal cycle is rigged. The appraisal process is unfair and there is no transparency. 
- There is no opportunity to grow with the organisation anymore. Unless you can bootlick the right people. 
- There is barely any opportunity to learn or be creative or innovative because brands and partners don’t want to associate themselves as much with ShareChat Moj anymore.
- Your work will go unnoticed. 
- Work culture has gone to the dogs. It’s a tense atmosphere because anybody can get fired anytime. It’s toxic and tense. 
- Only sales people are relevant right now. Even with money not coming in for months & months. 
- Cost-cutting in every manner is the only constant. 
- There is barely any functional dynamic between and in teams due to lack of resources and panic about layoffs.

Product managers are toxic. Most of the iOS team got fired (both dev and qa) was because of poor product managers (they always gave importance to Android team). Even Grooming sessions was happening only to the Android team. 
Pod lead of QA SC consumer experience is again toxic. From day 1 of his joining, he works only for promotion (basically talking. You could not find him performing any feature testing or providing support to the team in terms of testing). This guy is from somewhere around Andra Pradesh (i guess) and he always talks in Hindi during meetings (so many people told him to speak in English directly and indirectly many times) and also updates messages in slack channels in Hindi only. reviews.cons: The way they do business and run teams is terrible, Every quarter there will be a transition in the teams and new targets and new dimensions all together, It will be very difficult to adapt and after achieving and over achieving the targets also they will one fine day deactivate our Email and Slack and Layoff us after a tenure of more than 4 years, So if you are fine with you getting laid off after working real hard then please go a head and apply for a job in ShareChat

Toxic work culture. Ridiculous management. No hike, No promotion. Full of favouritism. Managers are doing monopoly. Only favourites and shoe lickers were promoted and saved during lay off. There was one manager who was handling team very well. But suddenly a senior manager came and destroyed everything. He targeted few senior employees who were fearless, dedicated during work. One senior QA was very friendly with us. He was having lot of personal issues but still was giving his best in work. But he also got laid off along with manager without any promotion. Manager was asking us about us complaint about him so that he could stop his promotion and hike. It was so cheap in a well established company. Other few senior QAs were also so good.  But manager started targeting them and pushed his personal favourites who were average in work. As a result, good people were kicked out, few resigned and few left through lay off. No HRs did any investigation. Even I got laid off just because he wanted to keep a contractual girl in the project. After observing the downfall of the team with in 2 years, I must say that this company is not good for QAs. They have use and throw policy. So please dont join this company for the sake of salary hike. they will destroy your career.

reviews.cons: Culture of laying off people without prior notice.

Toxic work culture.  Your entire experience in the company depends on the team you work with.
Do not blindly believe on the reviews and ratings given online.
No proper communication between the product and the engineering team.
They haven't spent any money on office infrastructure. They have a very small office which can accommodate max of 50 people. You are not allowed to wear shoes or sandals inside the office, which is very weird. Cafeteria is too small. Max 10 people can fit it. Wash basin is filthy, where we are forced to wash our hands in unhygienic condition, with food all around on the floor.
For juniors there are no proper mentors to guide. No clear visibility for career growth.
The app they have created are just clones of Instagram and Tiktok. 
Micro management by seniors. No hike or change of designation.
Designation is not given based on experience. When they receive any funding they hire aggressively and when they run out of funds they fire employees the very next day.
There is zero job stability. Join this company only if you are fresher and ready to get fired any moment. They tempt you with huge ESOP(stock options) in the beginning. You should know you can never encash them by selling because only if the company decides to buy back you get some amount, which never happens.
"You are not performing as expected" is the usual excuse used by the company to fire employees. The labour laws in the country should be changed strictly to stop such malpractices. 
Given a choice to choose between a start up and an MNC, please join any MNC. MNC always has job stability compared to these short shelf life start up's.
